name: Pyielink
description: Pyielink remote access framework — screen sharing, file transfer, and terminal access
info:
Pyielink v0.5.0 remote access framework

Connect to remote host via: pyielink user@ip

Features:
- Screen sharing with FFmpeg + openh264
- Audio capture and playback via FFmpeg/Opus
- File transfer with resume support
- Multi-monitor selection and focus-gated capture
- Adaptive bitrate and frame pacing
- IP whitelist and --all tunneling flags
- Persistent token-based authentication
- On-screen OSD overlay (FPS, bitrate, RTT, input stats)
- In-app file browser with SVG icons

Connect:
  pyielink user@192.168.1.100    # GUI mode
  pyielink --repl user@192.168.1.100  # REPL terminal mode
  pyielink enable                 # Enable host for connections
  pyielink enable --all           # Open host to any IP
  pyielink enable --whitelist IP  # Allow specific IP only
  pyielink whitelist add IP       # Add IP to persistent whitelist
  pyielink whitelist remove IP    # Remove IP from whitelist

First run: npm install -g pyielink
  Downloads Rust binary from CDN and sets up configuration.

Docs:  https://github.com/EMTYPYIE/Pyielink
Support: Issues https://github.com/EMTYPYIE/Pyielink/issues
